name: Too Darn Cute
body:
The Hearthskeeper has blessed you with exceptional cuteness, whether physical or in your personality (or both!).

Prerequisite: Patron deity is a god of halflings

Benefit: Three times per day you gain a +2 divine bonus to any Charisma-based skill checks.
